prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving through an intersection in Houston, Texas, trying to make a left turn across the lanes to get into a parking lot.

Q: What was the traffic signal showing for you?

A: It was a solid green for my direction, but I had a yield arrow situation where I needed to wait for oncoming traffic to clear. I was waiting for a gap when the other vehicle hit my passenger side.

Q: Wait, you said the other vehicle hit your passenger side. Was it coming toward you or from behind?

A: It was coming from the opposite direction, straight through the intersection. I didn't see it until it was too late.

Q: Did you have your turn signal on?

A: Yes, I had it on for a good stretch before I started to move.

Q: Were there any passengers in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Can you tell me about your injuries?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the door panel. It's swollen and I've had trouble putting weight on it. I was told I might need an MRI.

Q: Have you seen a doctor yet?

A: I went to urgent care the same day and they sent me for imaging. I have a follow-up scheduled with my regular physician next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car fixed and my knee looked after.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
